title: 第二十六章使者
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
“凭我的一身手段，还有规矩。”

    “师父常说，功夫再高也压不住人心，只有规矩才能。”

    张守安“嗯”了一声，把刘全叫来：“那这里的事情，我全交给你们了。”

    “我只负责杀妖与斩人。”

    两人作揖：“是。”

    麻烦事告一段落，张守安终于得以空闲几分钟。

    他看着两人走出营帐，终于喘了口气。

    在自己的椅子上，慢慢闭上了眼睛，不久就陷入梦乡。

    自从枯木村开始，他就没有真正闲下来一分钟，不是在杀妖，就是在杀同门的路上。

    现在好不容易静了下来，当然要好好睡一会。

    天色慢慢暗了下来，张守安也是终于睡醒。一睁开眼，身旁空无一人。

    他揉了下眼，鼻间呼出口气，缓缓站直僵硬的身躯。

    这时，刘全从营帐外走了进来，他一见张守安便躬身作揖道：“大人，东面二熊山的两位熊妖派使者来了。”

    张守安疑惑：“妖物派使者来干嘛。”

    刘全说道：“说是要邀请王猛几人去参加他们大王的婚礼。”

    张守安一笑，妖物还办上婚礼了，倒是越来越像人了。

    他看向刘全：“说说他们大王。”

    刘全立刻解释道：

    “二熊山里面盘踞着两只熊妖，是咱们这地界里东面势力最大的一伙。”

    “大的自称熊大爷，筑基初期，擅长使一根混铁棍，据说重达五百斤。一棍下去，可碎石破城。”

    “小的自称熊二爷，练气圆满，使一对铜锤，虽然笨重，可手上动作却是极其精巧，使得花式频出。”

    “两只妖物占山为王已有多年，虽然实力强大，但却是有个实实在在的癖好。”

    “这两只熊都极其好色，往往在山路上拦着过往的商队，游人，凡是有漂亮的女子，都要掳到山上，强娶为妻子。”

    “至于这次为什么要办婚礼，倒是不知道了。”

    他顿了顿，但是在对上张守安的眼神后，还是开口：
content_en:
"With my skills and rules."

    "Master often says that no matter how good your skills are, you can't suppress people's hearts, only rules can."

    Zhang Shou'an said "hmm" and called Liu Quan over: "Then I'll leave all the matters here to you."

    "I am only responsible for killing monsters and beheading people."

    The two of them bowed and said, "Yes."

    The trouble came to an end and Zhang Shou'an finally had a few minutes to spare.

    He watched the two people walk out of the camp and finally took a breath.

    Sitting on his chair, he slowly closed his eyes and soon fell into sleep.

    Since the beginning of Withered Wood Village, he hasn't really had a minute to spare. He is either killing monsters or killing fellow sect members.

    Now that I have finally calmed down, of course I need to have a good sleep.

    The sky gradually darkened, and Zhang Shouan finally woke up. When I opened my eyes, there was no one around me.

    He rubbed his eyes, exhaled through his nose, and slowly stood up straight.

    At this time, Liu Quan walked in from outside the camp. When he saw Zhang Shou'an, he bowed and said, "Sir, the two bear demons from Erxiong Mountain to the east have sent envoys."

    Zhang Shouan was confused: "Why did the monster send the envoy here?"

    Liu Quan said: "I want to invite Wang Meng and others to attend their king's wedding."

    Zhang Shouan smiled, the monster even held a wedding, and it became more and more like a human being.

    He looked at Liu Quan: "Tell me about their king."

    Liu Quan immediately explained:

    "There are two bear demons entrenched in Erxiong Mountain. They are the most powerful group in the east of our territory."

    "The older one calls himself Uncle Xiong. In the early stages of foundation building, he is good at using an iron rod, which is said to weigh up to five hundred kilograms. One stick can crush rocks and destroy the city."

    "The younger one calls himself Mr. Xiong. He has perfected his qi training and made a pair of copper hammers. Although heavy and heavy, the movements in his hands are extremely delicate, allowing him to perform frequent tricks."

    "The two monsters have been kings of the mountain for many years. Although they are powerful, they have a real hobby."

    "These two bears are extremely lustful. They often block passing caravans and tourists on the mountain road. Any beautiful women will be kidnapped to the mountains and forcibly married as wives."

    "As for why there is a wedding this time, I don't know."

    He paused, but after meeting Zhang Shou'an's eyes, he still spoke:
